2609.34904.title: Reference-Tail Trust:Certified Probability Floors for Learned Updates Inside a Deployed Network
2609.34904.paper_summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) need to exploit improved message passing without surrendering control over predictions already trusted in deployment. We introduce Reference-Tail Trust (RTT), a framework that admits learned updates inside a frozen GNN and certifies the prediction actually served. RTT couples graph-based proposal states with a constrained internal optimizer: each displacement is charged for its worst-case terminal cross-entropy increase through the incumbent's remaining message-passing layers. A trajectory-validated tube and an independent checker enforce per-node probability floors, $p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$, and a call-level budget, $\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$, uniformly over labels. Calls whose adapted outputs pass certification require no separate full incumbent rollout; failed certificates trigger whole-call fallback. We derive the exact probability-floor frontier by water-filling, characterize architecture-constrained efficiency, and establish conditions under which internal propagation exploits evidence unavailable to restricted output correctors. In the reported ogbn-arxiv audit, RTT achieves $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats of mean gain per call, with a one-sided 95% regression-rate upper bound of 0.95% and a 95% negative-flip upper bound of 0.51% on the uninspected part of the reserved node population. Its mean gain is 61% of a cross-fitted posterior-based frontier estimate and exceeds the strongest matched one-pass corrector by $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats. Reported experiments span eight proposals, six graph-incumbent families, structural and temporal graph shifts, and molecular prediction, with additional image and tabular evaluations. RTT makes GNN adaptation a budgeted, certifiable inference decision rather than an unconditional model replacement.
2609.34904.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）需要在不放棄對已經信任的預測控制的情況下，利用改進的消息傳遞。我們引入了參考尾信任（RTT），這是一個允許在凍結的 GNN 中進行學習更新並證明實際提供的預測的框架。RTT 將基於圖的提議狀態與受限的內部優化器結合：每個位移都會因其在現任者剩餘的消息傳遞層中造成的最壞情況終端交叉熵增加而被收費。經過軌跡驗證的管道和獨立檢查器強制每個節點的概率下限，$p^{\mathrm{s}}_{ic} \ge e^{-H_{\mathrm{row}}} p^{\mathrm{r}}_{ic}$，以及調用級別預算，$\sum_i w_i D_\infty(p^{\mathrm{r}}_i \| p^{\mathrm{s}}_i) \le H^+$，在標籤上均勻適用。那些經過調整的輸出通過認證的調用不需要單獨的完整現任者展開；失敗的證書會觸發整個調用的回退。我們通過水填充推導出確切的概率下限邊界，表徵架構受限的效率，並建立內部傳播利用對受限輸出修正器不可用的證據的條件。在報告的 ogbn-arxiv 審核中，RTT 每次調用達到 $6.5\times 10^{-3}$ nats 的平均增益，單邊 95% 回歸率的上限為 0.95%，而 95% 負翻轉的上限則為 0.51%，針對未檢查的保留節點群體。其平均增益為基於交叉擬合後驗邊界估計的 61%，並超過最強的匹配一次性修正器 $+0.9\times 10^{-3}$ nats。報告的實驗涵蓋八個提案、六個圖形現任者家族、結構和時間圖形變化，以及分子預測，還包括額外的圖像和表格評估。RTT 使 GNN 的適應成為一個有預算的、可證明的推斷決策，而不是無條件的模型替換。
